mechanism: Fine-tuning (multi-turn SFT and DPO) of a guide model that steers code versus text generation
evidence_scope: We fine-tune the Llama-3-8B model with a newly designed multi-turn supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO).
evidence_role: We introduce CodeSteer, an effective method for guiding LLM code/text generation.
